Built for this platform

What you can do with LinkedIn Ads MCP

01

Read B2B campaign performance

Report on account, campaign, and creative-level spend and available conversion metrics. The connector does not invent an ad-group level that LinkedIn does not have.

02

Navigate campaign groups

List campaign groups and campaigns, including inactive ones. Select an existing group before preparing a paused campaign under it.

03

Make budget and status changes explicit

Preview daily or total budget updates. Campaign creation and activation require the advertiser’s explicit non-political confirmation; your agent should not infer that consent.

Know what the data means

Reporting has a 15,000-element response ceiling; ceiling results are flagged as potentially truncated. Campaign creation does not create creatives or lead forms. Political campaigning and group-shared dynamic-budget creation are not exposed.

Local setup · Bring your own credentials

Connect LinkedIn Ads to Claude Code or Cursor.

The npm CLI and MCP server run on your machine. You need Node.js 22.13 or newer, your own provider credentials, and permission to access the ad account.

01 Install Adport

npm install -g adport

02 Connect LinkedIn Ads

adport connect linkedin

The local wizard imports your authorized token and checks account discovery. Access-only tokens require reauthorization when they expire; an account appearing in discovery does not by itself prove reporting permission.

03 Check your connection

adport doctor
adport accounts --provider linkedin

Check that the intended account appears before asking your agent to report on it. Never paste tokens, client secrets, or private keys into chat.

Before you connect

  • A LinkedIn developer app associated with a real Company Page and approved for the Advertising API.
  • An authorized ad-account member and permissions appropriate to the task, including rw_ads and r_ads_reporting for this read/write surface.
  • An access token obtained through your app’s approved flow, supplied securely as LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN. Refresh grants are available only to eligible partners.
Full LinkedIn Ads connection guideOfficial LinkedIn Ads API documentation

Adport is independent and is not endorsed by LinkedIn Ads. Provider access and approval are separate from installing this package.

Use LinkedIn Ads from your agent.

LinkedIn Ads in Claude Code

After connecting locally, register Adport as a stdio MCP server:

claude mcp add --transport stdio adport -- adport mcp

Start a new session and ask Claude to list your connected LinkedIn Ads accounts.

Claude Code MCP documentation

LinkedIn Ads in Cursor

Add this entry to your Cursor MCP configuration. Merge it with existing servers rather than replacing them:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "adport": {
      "command": "adport",
      "args": [
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

The command must be available on Cursor’s PATH. Enable the server and ask the agent to inspect your account.

You stay in control

A suggestion is not a live change.

The first mutation call returns a preview and a short-lived pending-operation token. Applying requires that token and the same arguments. Budget caps and protected accounts are checked by the policy engine; new campaigns are paused by policy.

Local operations are recorded in an append-only audit log. An approved preview is not a guarantee of provider acceptance, and a connected agent does not grant additional account permissions.

LinkedIn Ads MCP questions

Can LinkedIn reports be grouped by ad group?

No. LinkedIn has campaigns, campaign groups, and creatives, but no native ad-group entity. Adport rejects the unsupported ad_group report level instead of relabeling campaigns.

Can I use LinkedIn Ads locally without Adport Cloud?

Yes. Install Adport from npm, connect your own LinkedIn Ads credentials, and register the local MCP server with a stdio-compatible agent such as Claude Code or Cursor. Your provider may have its own approval, access, or billing requirements.

Why can I connect an account but not read a report or apply a change?

Account discovery, reporting, and mutations can require different permissions. Check the requested account, provider app scopes, advertiser eligibility, and environment. Start with adport doctor and the connection guide above. Do not bypass a denied operation by sharing secrets with the agent.
